verdict.rationale: stagewise is an agentic desktop IDE with a managed cloud and inference service, so a public versioned API with a deprecation policy is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack documents no versioned API and no deprecation policy, and probes for OpenAPI specs at the docs site all returned 404. The BYOK and custom-provider API styles describe consuming third-party model APIs, not stagewise offering its own versioned API, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
